topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Prioritizing high-revenue services over navigation safety margins affects link budgets by reducing resources for navigation signals, increasing interference susceptibility. Techniques like ACM, beamforming, and MU-MIMO optimize resource allocation, balancing service quality and safety. AI predicts channel conditions, ensuring reliable link budget management.
reference_context: QoS provisioning in satellite networks requires link characteristic identification, traffic requirement analysis, and admission control to ensure reliable communication.
